title: Space dots: one window for every space (Leo 2026-11-11: "it's essentially all the same window in a way if you want it to be")

steps.title: An explicit Move to New Window: a second window now shows Default too (the screenshot's case)
Hover the Default dot in the first window: the tooltip names the space alone
Click the Default dot: the other window's Default workspaces come into this window, which closes it
Hover the Work dot: its tooltip
Click the current space's dot: the space menu names every space, then New Space and New Incognito Space
steps.optional: an open NSMenu tracks on the main thread; a runner whose control socket waits on it captures nothing
